name: stream-deck-coding-agents
description: Elgato Stream Deck plugin that shows your Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI sessions as live tiles: state, timer, tool, streamed text and a breathing orb. Press to open the session window, hold to approve.
author: Gabriel Vaz

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:lib && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.gabrielvaz.coding-agents.sdPlugin --output dist --force
scripts.link: npm run build && streamdeck link com.gabrielvaz.coding-agents.sdPlugin
scripts.gallery: npm run build:lib && node scripts/render-gallery.mjs && node scripts/render-inspector.mjs
scripts.gifs: npm run build:lib && node scripts/render-gif.mjs pulse,clawd,glow,minimal
